notes.title: Nukitashi” Visual Novel Receives Anime Adaptation
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/34798748/2837e2d46d718ead97526fc10d42d3bf9a1a8393.png[/img]
We are thrilled to share that the acclaimed adult visual novel “Nukitashi” is set to receive an anime adaptation titled “Nukitashi the Animation.” Produced by Passione and directed by Nobuyoshi Nagayama, this adaptation brings the unique narrative of “Nukitashi” to a broader audience. ￼

This development underscores the growing recognition and mainstream acceptance of adult visual novels, highlighting their rich storytelling and complex characters. As developers dedicated to crafting immersive experiences, we find this trend encouraging and are inspired to continue pushing the boundaries of our narratives.

Hey Spooky Gamers!

It's that time of year again when the pumpkins are glowing and the ghosts are roaming. Happy Halloween from all of us at King Key Games! We hope your day is filled with frights, delights, and plenty of candy.

But what's Halloween without a little bit of ruling? 🏰 Dive into the spirit of the season with our game, "King of Halloween." As the night of scares and terrors unfolds, why not take on the role of a ruler in a realm where every shadow could be a friend or foe?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1148260/

Explore eerie lands, make chilling decisions, and try to keep your crown while surrounded by spirits and spooks. It’s the perfect game to get into the Halloween mood, with thrills and chills around every corner!

So, light your jack-o'-lanterns, don your capes, and prepare for a night of spooky fun with "King of Halloween." Let's see if you can survive the night and keep your throne!

Wishing you a hauntingly joyful Halloween full of screams and dreams. Stay spooky and keep gaming!

notes.title: King Key Games Survey Part 2 CLOSED - Thank you to all that participated
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34798748/2b370b978ebba63f37577823a471256f2038e672.png[/img]

Yo Dawgs,

This time we had a truly amazing amount of people submit responses for the new survey. Thank you ever so much to all that participated! We decided at the end that everyone that gave valid responses will be receiving a free game key.

Since a lot of the questions had long form answers, it will take a lot of time to go through all of these so give Ol' Uncle Ricky a while to get back to y'all. If your survey passed the screening test and had valid answers you should receive an email in a couple of days asking you what game you want. If you haven't received an email, one of these conditions may have happened:

1. You didn't type in your email properly. In both surveys, you'd be shocked how many people didn't type their emails in properly and we got replies from mailer-daemons. 

2. You didn't answer in English.

3. You answered the long form questions with either a single word or with a nonsense answer. This happened quite a bit. Quite a few people seemed to have not read the rules and instructions on the form and just rushed through with single word responses.

Just so y'all know, the vast majority of people didn't do anything wrong, but if you don't get an email from me by Friday then you probably fell under one of the above three categories.

For the most part, the answers were real insightful and will help towards us making you better games, so thanks for that!

Peace!

Ricky

notes.title: DLC for King of Volleyball Coming Soon
notes.notes:
Yo Dawgs!

Hope y'all are enjoying our first ever yuri game! Something about two lovely ladies getting it on is so extra delicious, isn't it?

Anyway, as many of you may have noticed, we don't have our DLC and Gold Edition pack out yet. This is due to the fact that now soundtracks are their own special thing and Ol' Uncle Ricky made a mistake getting the store page out for that one! That is my bad!

I do hope that when it does come out some of y'all come back to buy it as we have some really amazing music in this game (with lots of Reggae and Latin Jazz tracks). 

In the Gold Edition we'll also be having a very tasty artbook. A must buy for any art aficionado!

For now I encourage y'all to play our new game and enjoy and once the DLC comes out please upgrade to the Gold Edition when you get the chance!

Peace!

Ricky
